step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify the actor node: 'Agent' (labeled 'deep Agent') on the left side, mapped to 'UserCompanyAgent'.
2. Identify CloudFront nodes and attached Lambda@Edge functions:
   - 'CloudFront' (Amazon CloudFront service icon).
   - 'VIEWER REQUEST' Lambda@Edge function above CloudFront (service 'LambdaAtEdge').
   - 'ORIGIN RESPONSE' Lambda@Edge function below CloudFront (service 'LambdaAtEdge').
3. Identify backend databases and storage on the right side of the green dashed line:
   - Top 'DYNAMODB' icon (service 'DynamoDB').
   - Middle 'DYNAMODB' icon (service 'DynamoDB').
   - Bottom 'S3' icon (service 'S3').
4. Extract arrow connections:
   - Agent -> CloudFront (labeled 'get').
   - Viewer Request Lambda@Edge -> Top DynamoDB.
   - Viewer Request Lambda@Edge -> Middle DynamoDB.
   - CloudFront -> S3.
   - S3 -> CloudFront.
